headline: Falcons hit 80 points across two wins
summary: Atlanta beat New Orleans 45–24 to reach 2–2 after scoring just 16 points in its opening two games. ESPN reports that Michael Penix Jr.'s return has helped revive the offence: Bijan and Brian Robinson combined for five rushing touchdowns against the Saints. The Falcons face Baltimore next.
